title: Derivatives within a set agree on the span of its curve tangent vectors (parent step 7b)
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, let M ⊆ ℝ^P be any set, f : ℝ^P → ℝ, f' : ℝ^P → ℝ a continuous linear map, and x, v ∈ ℝ^P. If f has derivative f' within M at x (HasFDerivWithinAt f f' M x) and v lies in the linear span of tangentSpace M x (the velocities γ'(0) of C¹ curves γ on (−1,1) with values in M and γ(0) = x), then fderivWithin ℝ f M x v = f'(v).
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (f : Euclid P → ℝ) (f' : Euclid P →L[ℝ] ℝ) (x v : Euclid P), HasFDerivWithinAt f f' M x → v ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x) → fderivWithin ℝ f M x v = f' v
